concerns.text: Task T035 (TCS calculation) contains a hallucinated description about 'thermoelectric performance' and a DOI citation (PhysRevB.99.125401) unrelated to phase boundary topology. The spec (SC-004, US-3) requires a Topological Consistency Score based on phase boundary ordering, not thermoelectric efficiency. This task fails to cover the required SC-004 logic.

Task T022 (Property Range Extrapolation) is marked as incomplete (checkbox unchecked) despite being a prerequisite for T021 (LOSO training) per the plan's Methodology 3. Without this task, the 'New Element' check and convex hull artifact generation required by FR-010 and Plan Methodology 3 are missing.

Tasks T024 (Null Model Baseline) and T025 (Permutation Test) are marked as incomplete. These are required to satisfy FR-009 (baseline comparison) and SC-008 (statistical significance p < 0.05). The spec mandates a statistically significant reduction in MAE; without these tasks, the validation loop is broken.

Task T028 (Resource Monitor) is marked as incomplete. While SC-003 defines the constraint (4h/7GB), the plan explicitly requires a 'Resource monitoring wrapper' to enforce this (Methodology Section 5). The absence of this task leaves the computational envelope constraint unimplemented.

Task T031 (Integration test for plot generation) is marked as incomplete. US-3 requires an independent test verifying PNG/SVG output exists. Without this task, the visualization story (US-3) lacks its mandatory test coverage.

The description for T035 includes a specific DOI citation (10.1103/PhysRevB.99.125401) and text about 'thermoelectric efficiency' which appears to be stale or hallucinated content from a different research context. This text must be removed and replaced with the actual TCS algorithm description (partial match ratio of sorted temperatures).
